criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use an elevated isometric projection with matching diagonal ground axes.
Routes and structures recede along a closely matched yaw and pitch.
different: REFERENCE alternates tighter landmark framing with broader terrain views; CANDIDATE framing is more uniformly tile-map centered.

evidence.observation: G02 shows the elevated isometric ground plane and diagonal route axes.
G02 uses nearly the same isometric pitch, yaw, and diagonal recession.
G08 is tightly framed around a large industrial landmark.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Pylons remain mid-scale objects beside buildings in both images.
Stacks and facility blocks retain comparable isometric silhouettes.
different: REFERENCE plants and substations more often dominate their crops.
CANDIDATE favors repeated small buildings, making several pylons comparatively oversized.

evidence.observation: G01 is dominated by a large plant compound with an attached pylon.
G01 contains smaller separate buildings, a stack, and a relatively prominent pylon.
G08's industrial complex occupies most of the crop.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both use charcoal-brown industrial terrain with cyan and amber accents.
Warm windows and fixtures glow against dark metal and soil.
different: REFERENCE has stronger metal, concrete, rock, and midtone separation.
CANDIDATE surfaces read flatter and more repetitively tiled, with weaker material cohesion.

evidence.observation: G03 separates rocky ground, dark infrastructure, water, and luminous conductors.
G03 uses a darker, flatter tiled ground and road fabric.
G08 shows layered blackened metal, smoke, masonry, and amber illumination.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both distinguish cyan energized routes from amber planned routes.
Both combine routes with pylons, nodes, and multi-segment paths.
different: REFERENCE conductor bundles visibly integrate with towers and substations.
CANDIDATE routes more often read as simplified floating strokes or dashed guides beside towers.

evidence.observation: G04 shows cyan conductors plus an amber node-and-pylon route with clear state distinction.
G04 preserves cyan and amber routing but uses simpler lines with looser tower attachment.
G05 contains tower-linked cyan and amber paths, circular nodes, and a warning marker.
